verses.text: The Mighty One, God, Jehovah, hath spoken, And called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

segments.text: The Mighty One, God, Jehovah, hath spoken,

verses.text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined forth.

segments.text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty,
God hath shined forth.

verses.text: Our God cometh, and doth not keep silence: A fire devoureth before him, And it is very tempestuous round about him.

segments.text: Our God cometh, and doth not keep silence:

verses.text: He calleth to the heavens above, And to the earth, that he may judge his people:

segments.text: He calleth to the heavens above,
And to the earth, that he may judge his people:

verses.text: Gather my saints together unto me, Those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

segments.text: Gather my saints together unto me,

verses.text: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness; For God is judge himself. [Selah

segments.text: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness;

verses.text: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify unto thee: I am God, even thy God.

segments.text: Hear, O my people, and I will speak;

verses.text: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices; And thy burnt-offerings are continually before me.

segments.text: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices;

verses.text: I will take no bullock out of thy house, Nor he-goats out of thy folds.

segments.text: I will take no bullock out of thy house,
Nor he-goats out of thy folds.

verses.text: For every beast of the forest is mine, And the cattle upon a thousand hills.

segments.text: For every beast of the forest is mine,
And the cattle upon a thousand hills.

verses.text: I know all the birds of the mountains; And the wild beasts of the field are mine.

segments.text: I know all the birds of the mountains;
And the wild beasts of the field are mine.

verses.text: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee; For the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

segments.text: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee;
For the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

verses.text: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, Or drink the blood of goats?

segments.text: Will I eat the flesh of bulls,
Or drink the blood of goats?

verses.text: Offer unto God the sacrifice of thanksgiving; And pay thy vows unto the Most High;

segments.text: Offer unto God the sacrifice of thanksgiving;
And pay thy vows unto the Most High;

verses.text: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

segments.text: And call upon me in the day of trouble:

verses.text: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, And that thou hast taken my covenant in thy mouth,

segments.text: But unto the wicked God saith,

verses.text: Seeing that thou hatest instruction, And castest my words behind thee?

segments.text: Seeing that thou hatest instruction,

verses.text: When thou sawest a thief, thou consentedst with him, And hast been partaker with adulterers.

segments.text: When thou sawest a thief, thou consentedst with him,

verses.text: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, And thy tongue frameth deceit.

segments.text: Thou givest thy mouth to evil,

verses.text: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; Thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.

verses.text: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; Thou thoughtest that I was altogether such a one as thyself: But I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.

verses.text: Now consider this, ye that forget God, Lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver:
